preconditions.description: The input x is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) >= 1 and all(int(stdout.strip()) >= n_min for n_min in range(1, 101) if any(all(Ai_j == An_i_j and Ai_j == An_j_i and Ai_j == An_j_i for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1)) and sum(sum(1 for Ai_j in row) for row in A) == x and all(Ai_j == 0 or (Ai_j == 1 and all(Ai_pjq == 0 for p in [i-1,i+1] for q in [j-1,j+1] if 1 <= p <= n and 1 <= q <= n and (p != i or q != j))) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1)) for A in generate_matrices(n)))
postconditions.description: The output n is the smallest positive integer such that there exists a clear and symmetrical n×n matrix A with sharpness x. Here, generate_matrices(n) is a hypothetical function that generates all possible n×n binary matrices, Ai_j is the element at row i and column j, An_i_j = A[n-i+1][j], An_j_i = A[i][n-j+1], and the matrix is clear if no two adjacent cells (sharing a side) both contain ones.
